item.description: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued delivering strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres, port infrastructure facilities of Ukraine and ships involved in the delivery of military cargo to Ukraine. 📍 As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit in Nikolayev region: ▫️ in Ternovka, the Novya Pochta logistics centre, used for storing dual-use cargo intended to support the AFU; ▫️ at sea, a dry cargo ship delivering military-purpose cargo to the port of Nikolayev. 💥 In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering military and dual-use cargo to the port of Odessa was hit at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎯 First they cleared the skies, then – the strongholds Servicemen of the Sever Group of Forces told about the fighting for the settlement of
item.description: First they cleared the skies, then – the strongholds Servicemen of the Sever Group of Forces told about the fighting for the settlement of Annopolye in Kharkov region. 🎯 Before assaulting, the servicemen cleared the skies of enemy strike drones. Then artillery and UAV teams struck the positions of an AFU separate motorised infantry brigade and destroyed strongholds, firing points and field ammunition depots. ▫️ Assaultmen of the 128th Motorised Rifle Brigade (44th Army Corps) advanced through forest areas in poor visibility, supported by tube and rocket artillery. The fighters operated in small groups of two or three, while reconnaissance UAV operators adjusted their actions from the air. Task completed! Moving on 💪 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⚡️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29995

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region
continue to tighten the encirclement and expand the external control zone.
🔥
Fights are underway in the encirclement for the liberation
of Nikolayevka, Varvarovka, Nefedovka, and Chernoye (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU lost over 55 troops, a motor vehicle, and five ground-based robotic systems in the encirclement ring during the day.
📍
Russian troops expand the external control zone. Russian elements continue combat actions to establish control over the settlements of Prikolotnoye, Kotovka, and Gogino (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition, in Kharkov region
, manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit near Svetlichnoye, Slatino, Martovoye, Shirokoye, Bugaevka, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region).
🔥
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered
at formations of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and three territorial defence brigades close to Yuryevo, Barilovka, Radkovka, Velikaya Rybitsa, and Olshanka (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 295 troops, an armoured personnel carrier, two armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun in the Sever Group's area of responsibility.
↗️
The Zapad Group's units improved the situation along the front line and inflicted losses
on manpower and hardware of two mechanised assault brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Volchiy Yar, Berezovka, Blagodatovka, Tamarganovka, Osinovo, Maleyevka, and Grushevka (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 220 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade, one unmanned systems brigade of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Yasnogorka, Belenkoye, Nikolayevka, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, Druzhkovka, Semenovka, Kramatorsk, and Slavyansk (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 195 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 23 motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 12 October 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
🚩
As a result of active actions, units of the Tsentr Group of Forces liberated Lidino (Donetsk People's Republic).
💥
Russian troops engaged
manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one jaeger brigade, one air assault brigade of the AFU and three national guard brigades near Starorayskoye, Novoandreyevka, Maryevka, Novoyavlenka, Svyatogorovka, Belozerskoye, Veselaya Gora (Donetsk People's Republic), Andronovka, and Tarasovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
⚡️
In Dobropolye
(Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army
advanced in the central and northern-western parts of the city.
Marine units
continued to mop up the western quarters of the city and the territory of the Dobropolskaya mine.
💥
The enemy's attempt to deblock the AFU's encircled units by troops of up to a platoon without armour was thwarted.
📊
Over the past 24 hours, 216 buildings,
including four production facilities,
have been liberated
and up to 35 Ukrainian servicemen have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, up to 330 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, two electronic warfare stations, and one electronic reconnaissance station have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
🚩
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance to the depths of the enemy defence and liberated Nikolskoye in Zaporozhye region by resolute actions.
🔥
Manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, two air assault brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade have been hit near Ivanovka, Podgavrilovka, Kolomiytsy, Orestopol, Skotovatoye (Dnepropetrovsk region), Vasinovka, Ternovka, and Volnyanka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 275 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and 12 motor vehicles.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Formations of one mechanised brigade, one mountain assault brigade, one air assault brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU have been hit near Orekhov, Kushugum, Zapasnoye, and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 40 troops, 19 armoured fighting vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on the transport infrastructure facilities of Ukraine used for the interests of the AFU, the production workshops of unmanned aerial vehicles and their launching sites, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 149 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
five guided aerial bombs and 646 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total
, since the beginning of the special military operation,
the enemy has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
259,820
drones,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,202
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,786
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,701
field artillery and mortars,
▫️
74,309
support military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
